verses.text: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
He cuts off every branch in me that bears no fruit. Every branch that does bear fruit, he trims back so it can bear even more.
You’re already clean because of the message I’ve spoken to you.
Stay connected to me, and I’ll stay connected to you. A branch can’t produce fruit by itself; it has to stay on the vine. You can’t bear fruit unless you stay in me.
I am the vine; you are the branches. Whoever stays in me, and I in them, bears lots of fruit. Apart from me, you can do nothing. 🍇
If anyone doesn’t stay in me, they’re like a branch tossed aside that dries up. People gather those branches, throw them into the fire, and they burn.
If you stay in me and my words stay in you, ask for whatever you want, and it will be done for you.
“My Father is glorified when you bear much fruit; that is how you show you are my disciples.
Just as the Father has loved me, I have loved you. Stay in my love.
If you keep my commands, you’ll stay in my love—just as I’ve kept my Father’s commands and stay in his love.
I’ve told you these things so my joy can live in you and your joy can be complete.
“Here is my command: love one another the way I have loved you.
No one has greater love than this: to lay down your life for your friends.
You are my friends if you do what I command you.
I don’t call you servants anymore, because a servant doesn’t know what the master is doing. I’ve called you friends, because I’ve made known to you everything I heard from my Father.
You didn’t choose me; I chose you. I appointed you to go and produce fruit that lasts, so the Father will give you whatever you ask in my name.
“This is what I’m commanding you: love one another.
If the world hates you, remember it hated me first.
If you belonged to the world, the world would love its own. But you don’t belong to it. I chose you out of the world, and that’s why the world hates you.
Remember what I told you: ‘A servant isn’t greater than the master.’ If they persecuted me, they’ll persecute you too. If they kept my word, they’ll keep yours too.
They’ll do all this to you because of my name, since they don’t know the One who sent me.
If I hadn’t come and spoken to them, they wouldn’t be guilty of this sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
Whoever hates me also hates my Father.
If I hadn’t done among them works no one else has done, they wouldn’t be guilty of this sin. But now they’ve seen me and still hated both me and my Father.
This happened so the words written in their Law would come true: ‘They hated me for no reason.’
“When the Advocate comes—the Spirit of truth, whom I will send to you from the Father—he will speak up about me.
You will speak up too, because you’ve been with me from the beginning.
